confirm.deactivateDescription: {{name}} will be marked inactive and will no longer appear in new records and quotes.
confirm.reactivateDescription: {{name}} will be available again for new records and quotes.

registration.banner: This supplier registered on their own through the quotation or catalog link. Check the details and approve so they can be chosen in quotations and their prices used in the catalog.
registration.listBanner_one: {{count}} registration made by a supplier through the link is awaiting review.
registration.listBanner_other: {{count}} registrations made by suppliers through the link are awaiting review.

signupLink.title: Supplier sign-up link
signupLink.description: Send this link to new suppliers: they fill in their company details and what they supply, in Portuguese or Chinese. The registration arrives here as pending approval.
signupLink.offText: The link is off. Turn it on so new suppliers can register themselves.
signupLink.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the link and copy it manually.
signupLink.confirmDescription: The current link stops working. Registrations already received stay in the list.
signupLink.subject: Supplier registration · 供应商注册

signup.title: Register your company
signup.intro: Fill in your company details and what you supply. The purchasing team reviews the registration and will contact you.
signup.descriptionHint: Write in Portuguese, Chinese or both. Products and services are required in at least one language.
signup.productsRequired: Enter the products and services in Portuguese or Chinese.
signup.review: The purchasing team reviews every registration before approving it.
signup.sentDescription: We received the registration for {{fornecedor}}. The {{empresa}} purchasing team will review it and contact you.
signup.cnpjExists: This CNPJ is already registered. To update your details, contact the purchasing team.
signup.invalid: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
signup.tooMany: Too many submissions in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
signup.invalidDescription: This link was turned off or replaced. Ask the purchasing team for a new one.
